item.title: @faytuksnetwork: The JSC Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol, Russia has been struck by Ukrainian missiles. It produces electronic component
item.description: The JSC Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol, Russia has been struck by Ukrainian missiles. It produces electronic components and semiconductors used by many of Russia's missiles including Iskander, Kh-101, and Pantsir. The plant was previously struck on October 23rd.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

The JSC Proton-Elektrotex plant in Oryol, Russia has been struck by Ukrainian missiles. It produces electronic components and semiconductors used by many of Russia's missiles including Iskander, Kh-101, and Pantsir. The plant was previously struck on October 23rd.
